summary: Iteration 57: Parent Portal Admin Feature Testing - All tests PASS. Backend APIs for portal config and admin preview work correctly. Frontend shows admin mode with cadet selector, widget grid, edit mode with visibility/size/reorder controls, and save functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend parent.py correctly implements ADMIN_ROLES check for DCP, Commander, Executive Staff (line 233)
GET /api/parent/portal-config returns default widget config with visible, size, order fields
PUT /api/parent/portal-config correctly restricts to admin roles and saves to settings collection
GET /api/parent/admin-preview/participants returns sorted list of participants
GET /api/parent/admin-preview/{id} returns cadet data with check-in status, bunk, allergies
Frontend MyCadetPage.js correctly detects admin role via STAFF_ROLES array
Widget grid uses 4-column layout with SIZE_CLASSES: third=col-span-1, half=col-span-2, full=col-span-4
Edit mode shows visibility toggle, size dropdown, and reorder buttons on each widget
Save Layout button appears when configDirty is true and saves via PUT /api/parent/portal-config
Sidebar.js correctly shows Parent Portal link for senior staff with page_parent_portal permission (line 157)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing users and participants
context_for_next_testing_agent: Parent Portal Admin feature fully tested. Commander can access /my-cadet, see admin preview mode with cadet selector, select any cadet to preview their parent portal view, toggle edit mode to show visibility/size/reorder controls, change widget sizes (1/3, 1/2, Full), toggle visibility, reorder widgets, and save layout configuration. Parents see the configured layout when they log in.
